fullPassage: Parenting experts say children need to learn independence and resilience. But cities and suburbs don't offer safe walk and bike routes to school, malls kick teenagers out on the weekends, and free time disappears under a spreadsheet of activities. All of those "musts" take more of the parents' time or money to navigate, because the child can't do it on their own. As Darby Saxbe, a clinical psychologist, recently wrote in the New York Times, "underparenting requires structural change." Unlike most political experts, she's not just talking about economic policies like family leave and government-supported childcare. She's talking about actual physical structures, and the cultural change required to populate them. We need to "build back our tolerance for children in public spaces," she writes, "and create safe environments where lightly supervised kids can move around freely."

questions.passage: Parenting experts say children need to learn (A) and resilience. All of those "musts" take more of the parents' time or money to (B). We need to build back our (C) for children in public spaces.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 아이들은 독립심(independence)을 배워야 하고, 부모는 그 과정을 헤쳐나가야(navigate) 하며, 공공장소에서 아이들에 대한 관용(tolerance)을 되찾아야 한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ① independence — navigate — tolerance: 원문 일치

det.korean: 도시는 안전한(safe) 도보/자전거 통학로를 제공하지 않으며, 그녀는 실제 물리적(physical) 구조와 그것에 사람을 채울(populate) 문화 변화를 말한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ① safe — physical — populate: 원문 일치

questions.passage: Parenting experts say children need to learn ①<u>independence</u> and resilience. Cities and suburbs don't offer ②<u>safe</u> walk and bike routes to school. All of those "musts" take more of the parents' time or money to ③<u>navigate</u>. We need to create ④<u>dangerous</u> environments where lightly supervised kids can move around freely.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 안전한(safe) 환경을 만들어야 한다. ④ dangerous(위험한)는 safe의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ dangerous(위험한): 원문은 safe(안전한)
✅ ③ navigate: 원문 일치
